(b) {slug} -> {title}, which is the part the audit filed as 'make the required Slug field visible or explain which field supplies it': there is no Slug field, and a brace key is a FIELD SLUG reference, not a magic value — applyPattern (server/services/cms.service.ts:121-128) substitutes "" for a key naming no field, so '/menu/{slug}' on this collection resolves EVERY record to '/menu/' and they collide instead of generating; the editor flags the same thing at ContentViews.tsx:633-634 (`unknownKeys`). {title} is a field this collection actually has, and slug patterns are slugified on substitution (cms.service.ts:125,171), so it yields /menu/margherita. Scope stops there deliberately: the parent frame 1173:4825 is already named '[not-implemented] dynamic-pages — a typed template path can never match an exported page…', and CODE-TRUTH F12 confirms pageTemplatePath is a write-once free-text path with no editor writer, so the audit's 'expose editable template/URL fields' would be drawing a control the product does not have. rows.holdWhy: no font-size op exists in apply-queue.mjs OPS — this row records the target, it cannot apply it
rows.why: M19 — HELD, NOT EXECUTABLE. apply-queue.mjs's OPS set is {text, rename, resize, fill, hotspot, move, delete, add-text, add-rect, add-caption, append-text, rewire, clone-node} (apply-queue.mjs:67-68). None of them writes fontSize on an EXISTING node: `resize` sets width and explicitly preserves height on a TEXT (apply-queue.mjs:170-176 — it forces textAutoResize=HEIGHT and passes n.height), and `size` is accepted only by add-text, i.e. only for text this plan creates. So every row below is authored as a NO-OP (text == the node's current string) and held: if the hold were ever ignored the applier would report SAME and change nothing. THE ONE THING THAT WOULD UNBLOCK IT: a fontSize op in apply-queue.mjs (load the node's fonts, set fontSize, read it back) — or one use_figma script doing the same. SCOPE, separately: the verdict is CONFIRMED-AND-GENERALISED — the kit's 16/13 scale is used by exactly ONE of the 26 modal/popover boards read this pass (1170:4777), so adopting it is a re-scale of the whole family, a founder decision, not a defect repair. Only the three nodes the finding itself cites (46:2 · 2850:22371 · 1172:4840) are enumerated here. || THIS ROW: 2850:22372 is currently 'Delete 34 files?' at box 6836,21148,106,17 — title 14/Semi Bold h17 -> 16/Semi Bold h24 (kit: 46:6, 46:18, 46:39, 46:64, 46:77, 46:90, 46:107 are all 16/Semi Bold at h24)
